Our approach

How a case is documented.

Agree the baseline

Choose the question, the measure and a time period before work starts. For billing, the team can review aggregate claims, denials and payment data.

Record the changes

Document the work, compare the same measure over a comparable period and explain other factors that affect the result.

Get client approval

The client reviews the wording and the figures before publication. Healthcare examples exclude identifiable patient information.

Available by request

References and sample reports.

The firm is preparing its approved case studies. In the meantime, you can ask for a sample report using illustrative data, or a reference call subject to the client’s agreement.
